tutorial.slide1Text: An app to track your sessions, your stock and a few extra stats. Let's take a quick tour of the main features — less than a minute.
tutorial.slide2Text: From the "Add" page, choose what you're smoking, how much, date and time (editable if you forget in the moment). You can also attach location, photo, context and mood — all optional.
tutorial.slide3Text: Log your purchases in "Stock": the app automatically calculates how much you have left and estimates how long it'll last, deducting the sessions you log. When you run out, you can fix any discrepancies before closing it.
tutorial.slide4Text: In the Log you can search and filter past sessions. In Charts you'll find the calendar heatmap, trends over time, and monthly spending calculated on what you actually consumed, not on when you bought it.
tutorial.slide5Text: In Stats you can set a personal goal (e.g. max N sessions a week), read some automatic insights, and keep track of any tolerance breaks.
tutorial.slide6Text: Add friends to compare stats: they'll need to accept your request before you can see theirs. In Snapshots you'll find the latest photos from you and them.
tutorial.slide7Text: From here you manage theme, reminders, push notifications, and export your data as JSON or CSV whenever you want. You can review this tutorial again anytime from here.
